Retained flows show connections from 192.168.10.25 to 173.223.152.83 on port 443, including FLOW-C69B848C3A94 and FLOW-AF8741C3657B. Inference: the concentrated activity warrants investigation, but the limited sample and volume alone do not establish hostile flooding or service impact.

findings.observation: The DoS alert records 1137 flows, 16165 packets, two destination ports, and one source in its one-minute window.

next_steps.reason: Review connection behavior and available broader flow evidence to distinguish ordinary HTTPS activity from flooding.
